HONEST ANSWERS BEFORE BIG DECISIONS.

A storm, a leak or an insurance claim can feel overwhelming. My job is to slow the process down, document what matters and make sure you understand your options.

Do I have to file an insurance claim after an inspection?

No. An inspection gives you information. You decide what makes sense after reviewing the findings.

What if my roof does not need replacing?

I’ll tell you. Sometimes the right answer is a repair, maintenance or simply monitoring the roof.

Can I contact Glenn directly?

Yes. Call or text 214-924-3704, or email glenn@luxeroofingsolutions.com.
